title: Relay Round 08 silhouette separation versus character appeal
summary: Three native 104x128 integer-pixel silhouette studies compared broken relay-ring placement while holding Relay's body constant. A/B/C ring-to-body minimum gaps were 2.83/3.61/4.00 pixels with no direct overlap. B better isolates the left rim, C is top-heavy; these numerical tests check geometry but NOT artistic quality. A separate 112x100 angled CRT material-plane exercise was also completed. All designs still fail canonical character-art review because hood/head and shoulders remain generic/rounded; further angular asymmetrical silhouette and 3/4 perspective practice is required before effects or animation. Preserve this critical failure along with the evidence and continue the other study subjects.
